title: 第17章 葛颜傻眼了第18章 勾栏听曲
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
那声音，分明就是自己的亲传弟子葛颜的。
听到惨叫声，燕文冕又心软了。
但想起贤弟那些话，若不管教，别人以为是你燕某人有异心~
或者是下次，遇到的对手不再留手，直接给葛颜秒杀了。
我的好贤弟，用心良苦啊。
只能狠狠心管教管教了。
这个时候，行刑司长老欧阳林出现在燕文冕旁边。
“燕山主。”
“欧阳长老。”
两人点头，燕文冕的态度，明显就生分很多了。
“燕山主就在这边等一下吧，我亲自进去提人。”
“嗯。”
欧阳林推开行刑区的门，吩咐几句，惨叫声就停止了。
很快，葛颜被两个人抬了出来，浑身血淋淋的。
燕文冕的两个看门侍卫，从行刑司的手里，将人接了过来。
燕文冕看了一下惨兮兮的葛颜，心里有一丝不忍，但想起贤弟的话，眼里又多了一分坚毅。
贤弟堂堂结丹修为，本可以一巴掌拍死葛颜，看在自己的面子上，才放过葛颜一马，若不记住这次教训，就是在害葛颜。
区区一个远房表弟，算个屁啊，自个的性命才是最重要的好吗？
燕文冕卷起几人，化作一道光离去。
不过一会，燕文冕等人，就回到了燕子山。

一落地，燕文冕就让两个侍卫，去叫医药堂的人过来给葛颜医治。
两个侍卫连忙离去。
葛颜坐在椅子上，他见燕文冕迟迟没有说话。
燕文冕不是这样的人，他是个脾气很差的人，很容易因为一句话而暴怒，弟子被打，他应该更生气才对啊。
但燕文冕迟迟没有说话，到底是作何打算的呢？
葛颜突然觉得师尊怪怪的。
但师尊是个非常心软的人，自己只要哭惨，师尊肯定就心软，回头把那个曹立给弄死。
敢让自己颜面尽失，从此沦为笑柄，葛颜很恨，非常恨。
自己可是亲传弟子，亲传啊，多么骄傲的身份。
他从小就没受过挫折的，不管是生活还是修行，都是众星捧月的，现在受这种委屈，真的跟杀了他一样的难受。
再加上，曹立的天赋比自己还恐怖，葛颜也有点怕，怕宗门要曹立，舍弃了他。
各种小心思叠加起来，葛颜对曹立恨之入骨。
葛颜从椅子上站了起来，扑通一声跪下：“师尊，求您帮弟子报仇。”
葛颜咬着牙。“我要曹立死。”
背对着葛颜的燕文冕，一直在脑海里组建词语，要如何管教葛颜。
一直以来，他都是宠人的师尊，无有不依，今天要他狠下心，确实需要一番准备。
燕文冕突然听到葛颜的话，眼睛一瞪，回过头来，不敢置信：“逆徒，你在说什么？”
content_en:
That voice was clearly that of his direct disciple Ge Yan.
Hearing the screams, Yan Wenmian softened again.
But when I think of my dear brother’s words, if you don’t discipline me, others will think it’s you, Yan, who has different intentions~
Or next time, the opponent you encounter will no longer hold back and will be killed directly by Ge Yan.
My good brother, you have good intentions.
The only thing I can do is to discipline and discipline him mercilessly.
At this time, Ouyang Lin, the elder of the execution department, appeared next to Yan Wenmian.
"Master Yanshan."
"Elder Ouyang."
The two nodded, and Yan Wenmian's attitude was obviously very different.
"Master Yanshan, just wait here, I will go in personally to pick up the person."
"Yeah."
Ouyang Lin pushed open the door to the execution area and gave a few instructions, and the screams stopped.
Soon, Ge Yan was carried out by two people, covered in blood.
Yan Wenmian's two gatekeepers took the person from the hands of the execution department.
Yan Wenmian looked at the miserable Ge Yan and felt a little unbearable in his heart, but when he thought of his brother's words, his eyes became more determined.
The virtuous brother was a man of elixir cultivation. He could have slapped Ge Yan to death, but for his own sake, he let Ge Yan go. If he didn't remember this lesson, he would be harming Ge Yan.
Just a distant cousin, no big deal, your own life is the most important, okay?
Yan Wenmian rolled up a few people and turned into a ray of light and left.
After a while, Yan Wenmian and others returned to Yanzi Mountain.
As soon as he landed, Yan Wenmian asked two guards to call people from the medical hall to come over and treat Ge Yan.
The two guards left quickly.
Ge Yan sat on the chair and saw that Yan Wenmian didn't speak for a long time.
Yan Wenmian is not such a person. He is a person with a bad temper. He easily gets angry because of a word. When his disciple is beaten, he should be even more angry.
But Yan Wenmian didn't speak for a long time. What was his plan?
Ge Yan suddenly felt that his master was strange.
But the master is a very soft-hearted person. As long as he cries miserably, the master will definitely be soft-hearted and kill Cao Li.
Ge Yan hated it, very much, for daring to lose face and become a laughing stock.
He is his direct disciple, what a proud identity he is.
He has never suffered setbacks since he was a child. Whether it is life or cultivation, he has been praised by all the stars. Now that he is being wronged like this, it is really as uncomfortable as killing him.
In addition, Cao Li's talent was more terrifying than his own, and Ge Yan was also a little afraid, fearing that the sect wanted Cao Li and abandoned him.
All kinds of little thoughts were added up, and Ge Yan hated Cao Li deeply.
Ge Yan stood up from the chair and knelt down with a plop: "Master, please help your disciple take revenge."
Ge Yan gritted his teeth. "I want Cao Li to die."
Yan Wenmian, who had his back turned to Ge Yan, kept forming words in his mind on how to discipline Ge Yan.
He has always been a doting master, relying on everyone, and if he is to be ruthless today, he really needs some preparation.
Yan Wenmian suddenly heard Ge Yan's words, his eyes widened, he turned around and said in disbelief: "Traitor, what are you talking about?"
